inputs.hmlr_local_authority: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham

acceptance_checks: All three Python components pass deterministic self-tests before network work
Fetch the current official HMLR download page using a cookie jar and require exactly one Barking and Dagenham row
Require the row link to equal the official London_Borough_of_Barking_and_Dagenham.zip route
Follow the short-lived official redirect without storing the signed query URL
Require ZIP magic, safe member paths, no encryption, no symlinks, bounded member count and bounded compression ratio
Require exactly one non-empty GML archive member and record separate ZIP and GML SHA-256 hashes
Verify the persisted official page and GML byte counts and hashes before handing them to the measurement runner
For each of 11 points, query the official EA Composite 1m DTM survey-index OGC collection and hash the JSON response
Construct every primary metadata bbox from the canonical BNG point with a 5m margin and explicit EPSG:27700 bbox-crs
Request the primary metadata response geometry explicitly in EPSG:27700
Reject a primary metadata response whose final host, content type, Content-Crs or coordinate bounds conflict with the EPSG:27700 contract
Filter OGC BBOX candidates locally in BNG and require exactly one valid geometry intersecting the canonical point
Require filename, tilename, polygon_id, resolution, year, sd_flown and ed_flown before resolving survey metadata
Parse four-digit survey years as calendar years, never Unix timestamps, and require consistency with survey start or end year
Query the official EA time-stamped DTM ArcGIS layer as secondary QA only and hash its response
Download all 22 prepared EA WCS probe responses independently and require TIFF magic, EPSG:27700 and SHA-256 receipts
A failed QA request for one parcel must not suppress factual receipts for the remaining parcels
Bind each canonical EPSG:27700 point to exactly one current HMLR polygon; 15m proximity is candidate-only
Hash the exact polygon WKB, not only the containing GML file
Request a second DTM and DSM raster covering the full exact polygon, not only the 10m point window
Require EPSG:27700, approximately 1m pixels, full polygon coverage and finite pixels
Compute terrain height difference only as polygon DTM maximum minus polygon DTM minimum and record robust p95-p05 QA
Keep DSM as surface QA and never substitute DSM for the bare-earth DTM result
Withhold the business row until official Composite survey metadata is uniquely resolved and write factual fail-closed output with final_ready false for partial or blocked execution
